description: Targeted-keyword performance for a marketplace over a period: spend, impressions, clicks and attributed sales (marketplace currency), grouped by any mix of keyword, match type, campaign, campaign group and merchant. This is the single keyword- performance report for all three call sites. Filter keyword only to see every campaign competing on that keyword across the marketplace (campaign competition); filter os_client_id + campaign_id to see a keyword's performance inside specific campaigns; filter os_client_id and add campaign_type = 'performance' plus campaign_subtype IN ('os_ads_search', 'smart_shopping') to get a merchant's keywords across its PLA performance campaigns -- that pair of filters replaces a WHERE clause the retired merchant-keyword report hardcoded. Package-based campaigns are always excluded. campaign_id is the lowercased marketing_campaign_id.

keyword.description: The matched targeted keyword (lowercased). Mandatory filter: the keyword whose marketplace-wide campaign competition to report.

spend.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN k.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN k.cost * scc.conversion_factor ELSE 0 END), 0)
spend.description: Campaign ad spend on the keyword over the period, converted to the marketplace currency.

impressions.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN k.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN k.impressions ELSE 0 END), 0)

clicks.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN k.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN k.clicks ELSE 0 END), 0)

attributed_sales.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN k.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN k.program_per_click_timestamp_sales * scc.conversion_factor ELSE 0 END), 0)

query.REPORTING: SELECT __ATTRIBUTES__, __METRICS__ FROM reporting.os_ads_keyword_performance_report AS k INNER JOIN reporting.campaign_tagging_data AS ctd ON ctd.account_id = k.account_id AND ctd.campaign_id = k.campaign_id AND ctd.client_id = k.client_id INNER JOIN reporting.marketing_campaign_dimensions AS mcd ON ctd.client_id = mcd.client_id AND ctd.marketing_campaign_id = mcd.marketing_campaign_id INNER JOIN reporting.marketing_campaign_group_dimensions AS mcgd ON ctd.client_id = mcgd.client_id AND ctd.marketing_campaign_group_id = mcgd.marketing_campaign_group_id INNER JOIN reporting.clients AS mc ON mc.client_id = k.marketplace_client_id INNER JOIN reporting.clients AS cl ON cl.client_id = k.client_id INNER JOIN reporting.static_currency_conversion AS scc ON scc.from_currency = k.currency AND scc.to_currency = mc.currency WHERE mc.agency_id = '__AGENCY_ID__' AND k.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' AND (mcd.campaign_origin != 'PACKAGE_BASED' OR mcd.campaign_origin IS NULL) AND __FILTER__ GROUP BY __ATTRIBUTES_GROUP_BY__ ORDER BY __ATTRIBUTES_ORDER_BY__ LIMIT __LIMIT__ OFFSET __OFFSET__;
